Title: Karan's Day

Cast

1. Karan - 35 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Meenakshi - 31 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Hema - 58 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Vinod - 65 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
5. Rajesh - 37 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
4. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Karan stands in the bathroom. Hema, Vinod and Rajesh stand near him.]

Hema: "What lovely weather!"

[Karan shaves in front of the mirror.]

Karan: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Karan stands by the road. Hema, Vinod and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "Karan, look over here."

[Karan rides his motorbike to the market.]

Vinod: "Okay, Karan."

[Karan starts his scooter and rides off.]

Hema: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Karan drives the car to the office.]

Karan: "What next?"

[Karan gets out of the car.]

Rajesh (laughing): "Show me too!"

[Karan rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Hema: "That was fun!"

[Karan takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Karan: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The main road - Day

Vinod: "Let's begin."

[Karan starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Karan: "That's easy."

[Karan is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Karan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Karan steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Karan: "Dad, listen!"

[Karan's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Hema: "Yes, all right."

[Karan's car crashes into a pole.]

Meenakshi: "That's great!"

[A dog runs in front of Karan's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Meenakshi (excited): "Careful!"

[Karan loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Karan: "Exactly right."

Scene 4: The terrace - Day

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Meenakshi hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Hema (laughing): "I really enjoyed today."
